description: Route design work to the right dg skill automatically — detects what you are building (component, pattern, platform, gesture concern) via stack-agnostic signals and loads only the relevant rule cards. Craft-agnostic by design: no system assumed, choose one only when the context demands it.
Apply the craft-agnostic foundation layer: rhythm, spacing, type scale, motion, accessibility, intent — the substrate every dg rule builds on, written so it holds in any stack or none.
Build or fix a specific UI component with gesture-correct anatomy — button anatomy, touch targets, density, feedback — expressed craft-agnostically (no platform assumptions).
Design or review a multi-step flow — empty states, loading, error recovery, progressive disclosure — as craft-agnostic pattern cards.
When the target platform is known, bend the dg rules to it (Apple -> hig-*, Material -> m3-*) and load the corresponding module; otherwise stay craft-agnostic.

Audit a screen or project against the dg craft-agnostic rules; produces a prioritized deviation list with severity, the rule violated, and a proposed fix — never a bare score. Supports delta tracking between runs.
The deliberately system-free core: when no design system applies, this is the layer that decides how things feel — rhythm, motion, micro-interaction — the foundation hig/m3 build upon.
